execution: Current native assistant chooses individual tools and inputs after observing results. No model API, autonomous product, scripted optimizer, or known exact model identity is asserted.

task_family.physics: Frozen constant-property pressure-driven transverse conjugate-fin PDE, fully developed no-slip momentum and thermally developing flow; ideal fixed common pressure; zero-throughflow branch closure.
boundaries: Synthetic component task, not aircraft requirements or validation
Measured benchmark supports a bounded comparison, not validation of every new operating point
Fin-only mass excludes the illustrative CAD base
Pressure is straight-channel friction, not installed-system or fan requirement
No new constants, fitted correlations, property changes, or relaxed requirements

tools: inspect: verified model/candidate geometry and analytic hydraulic screening
evaluate: one candidate, one task case, one allowed mesh; actual frozen PDE solve
cad: create STEP/STL and independently round-trip check BRep/mesh for one candidate
finalize: verify selected candidate evidence, immutable task, convergence and CAD, then emit result

acceptance.fixed_task: Exact task JSON bytes hashed at initialization and checked on every action
acceptance.live_model: PDE source and inherited operator hashes pinned; no cached response substitutes for evaluate
acceptance.final_feasible: All cases evaluated on all three meshes, all numerical gates pass, each mesh Re<2300, fin mass <= fixed limit and temperature <= fixed limit
acceptance.cad: Actual kernel STEP roundtrip and closed STL; geometry dimensions and independent fin volume match thermal parameters; base thickness 3 mm is illustrative and excluded from fin mass
acceptance.failure_retention: Retain all errors, failed or out-of-scope evaluations and at least one rejected design where task permits. Infeasible outcomes are legitimate; untested candidates prohibit all-design infeasibility claims.
acceptance.no_optimum_claim: Objective is bounded feasibility or minimum among evaluated candidates only
acceptance.trace: Public chronological tool inputs, results, source/result hashes, concise decision summaries, errors, elapsed time and explicit human intervention count. No private chain of thought.
acceptance.heldout: Independent setter commits task hash after protocol freeze. Executor receives task only after freeze; report contamination/exposure and all amendments honestly. Same task family, not broad generalization evidence.
